page.overview:
What is Team 7?

Team 7 is a comic book superhero team that appeared in titles published by Wildstorm Productions. The team has appeared in three self-titled miniseries: Team 7, Team 7: Objective Hell and Team 7: Dead Reckoning.

The first 5-issue Gen13 limited series also involved members of Team 7. The team's members have played a major role throughout the Wildstorm Universe. In September 2011, The New 52 rebooted DC's continuity, bringing in Wildstorm characters, including Team 7.

Also known as: Squad 7, Kakashi's Team.
